segments.sn46.24:1.1: “Ayoniso, bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn46.24:1.2: anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn46.24:1.3: anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn46.24:1.4: anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn46.24:1.5: anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn46.24:1.6: anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo nuppajjati, uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo nirujjhati … pe … anuppanno ceva upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo nuppajjati, uppanno ca upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo nirujjhati.
segments.sn46.24:2.1: Yoniso ca kho, bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando nuppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyati;
segments.sn46.24:2.2: anuppanno ceva byāpādo nuppajjati, uppanno ca byāpādo pahīyati;
segments.sn46.24:2.3: anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ nuppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ pahīyati;
segments.sn46.24:2.4: anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nuppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyati;
segments.sn46.24:2.5: anuppannā ceva vicikicchā nuppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā pahīyati.
segments.sn46.24:3.1: “Anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati … pe … anuppanno ceva upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī”ti.

lines: Vuttaparicchedoti etena na kevalaṃ ārammaṇavaseneva, atha kho upanissayavasenapettha attho labbhatīti dasseti.
Paṭhamavaggassa hi dutiye sutte upanissayavaseneva attho dassito.
